name: Personalized Mirror Acrylic Light Box Picture Frame
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality wood and mirror acrylic, offering a warm, elegant, and modern display finish.
    - Features a wooden light box frame paired with a mirror acrylic panel for a refined and eye-catching decorative effect.
    - The mirror acrylic panel has a thickness of 3mm ~ 0.12 in, providing a sturdy and premium feel.
    - Built-in LED light inside the wooden frame enhances the engraved mirror design with a soft glowing effect.
    - The wooden frame is durable, stable, and neatly finished for long-term display use.
    - Available in 2 mirror acrylic options: Mirror Gold and Mirror Silver.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Wooden frame size: 15 x 19 x 3.2 cm ~ 5.91 x 7.48 x 1.26 in
    - Mirror acrylic panel size: 13.5 x 20 cm ~ 5.31 x 7.87 in
    📌 Note:  The shape is fixed and cannot be changed. Customers may customise only the printed design.

 

  • Engraving Technology:
    - Uses high-quality back engraving technology on mirror acrylic for sharp details and long-lasting design quality.

 

  • Lighting & Power Options:
    - Equipped with a built-in LED light inside the wooden frame.
    - USB powered for convenient daily use.
    - Available with 2 light control options:
                        +) Switch used for 7-color lights
                        +) Switch used for monochrome lighting
    - Easy to connect to laptops, power banks, adapters, and other USB-compatible power sources.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as both a personalized light box and a decorative picture frame display.
    - Designed to brighten up desks, shelves, nightstands, countertops, or memory corners with a warm illuminated effect.
    - Suitable for both horizontal and vertical display orientations depending on the design style.
    - The wooden frame and mirror acrylic combination adds a stylish and meaningful touch to home or office décor.
    - Perfect for showcasing names, heartfelt messages, and personalized artwork in an elegant lighted format.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A meaningful personalized gift for family members, friends, coworkers, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for birthdays, anniversaries, Mother’s Day, Father’s Day, Christmas, and special celebrations.
    - Ideal for memorial keepsakes, appreciation gifts, romantic gifts, and personalized home décor.
    - A thoughtful gift for anyone who loves elegant illuminated displays and custom keepsakes.
    - Great for bedroom décor, office décor, shelf display, and commemorative memory corners.
    - Adds a warm, refined, and heartfelt touch to any personal space🎁
     

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Personalized Mirror Acrylic Light Box Picture Frame

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.2-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.

Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
